blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Training multimodal search agents requires tasks that make visually grounded search necessary for determining the answer. Textual identity clues and unused target evidence allow shortcuts in synthetic questions, weakening supervision for visual search and evidence integration. We propose RACE, an image-conditioned task synthesis framework that constructs dependencies from images to targets and from target-specific evidence to answers. Referential Abstraction (RA) replaces identity-revealing text with specific visual references or ambiguous relational references resolved by searching among depicted candidates. Compositional Evidence (CE) links retrieved facts about multiple entities in one image or entities from different images into joint questions whose answers require every designated contribution. Both operations also apply to images found during search, allowing new visual observations to determine subsequent search targets or supply answer evidence. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B on only 12K teacher-generated trajectories from RACE raises average accuracy across ten multimodal benchmarks from 53.5 to 56.0, a relative improvement of approximately 4.7% over the matched base agent. Our code, data, and model will be publicly available.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal deep search requires agents to resolve targets in images, search for information about them, and combine evidence.
When search reveals further targets in new images, resolving these references determines what to investigate next.
Recent systems support multi-turn exploration, search guided by intermediate images, and concurrent search across entities ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Synthetic-data pipelines link evidence across search steps or entities to construct challenging questions, then collect successful teacher trajectories for fine-tuning.
Task structure governs whether answering these questions requires visual target resolution and joint evidence use.
blocks.zh:
多式联运深度搜索需要代理人解决图像中的目标,寻找有关它们的信息,并结合证据.
当搜索在新图像中揭示更多目标时,解决这些引用决定了下一步要调查什么.
最近的系统支持多回合探索,以中间图像为指导进行搜索,并同时进行跨实体的搜索(黄等人,2026b;张等人,2026b;李等人,2026).
合成数据管道将跨搜索步骤或实体的证据联系起来,以构建具有挑战性的问题,然后收集成功的教师轨迹进行微调.
任务结构决定回答这些问题是否需要视觉目标解析和联合证据使用.

blocks.en:
Our central insight is that task synthesis should make visually grounded search necessary for determining the answer.
This requires a dependency from images to targets and from target-specific evidence to the answer.
Textual identity clues let a solver bypass the first dependency by recovering the target without the image (Figure 1 (a)).
A question can mention two targets while using evidence from just one (Figure 1 (b)).
These shortcuts bypass visual target resolution or joint evidence use.
In the composed example, resolving the ambiguous reference assigns the two women’s facts to a directed comparison, whose answer requires both contributions (Figure 1 (c)).

文字身份线索让解析器绕过第一个依赖,通过恢复没有图像的目标(图1(a)).
一个问题可以提到两个目标,而只使用一个目标的证据(图1(b))。
这些快捷键绕过视觉目标分辨率或联合证据使用.
解决含糊不清的提法将两位妇女的事实置于直接比较之下,其答案需要双方的贡献(图1(c))。

blocks.en:
We introduce RACE (Referential Abstraction and Compositional Evidence), a framework that constructs these dependencies jointly from real images and retrieved evidence. Referential Abstraction (RA) ties target resolution to the image through specific visual references or ambiguous relational references verified by search.
For ambiguous relational references, construction searches every candidate, supports one match, rules out alternatives, and screens the reference for text-only identity leakage.
blocks.zh:
我们采用RACE(参考抽象和构成证据),这个框架从真实图像和检索到的证据中共同构建这些依存关系。 参考抽象(RA)通过特定的视觉参考或通过搜索核实的模棱两可的关系参考,将目标分辨率与图像联系起来.
对于模棱两可的关系引用,构建搜索每个候选,支持一个匹配,排除其他选项,并筛选仅文本身份漏洞的引用.

blocks.en:
Compositional Evidence (CE) makes the answer depend on every selected target’s evidence.
It connects retrieved facts through supported relations to construct a joint question about multiple entities in one image or one entity from each of several images.
The facts must jointly determine one answer, while removing any designated contribution leaves it undetermined.
RA therefore establishes whose evidence is relevant, and CE specifies how those contributions determine the answer.
This also supports multi-image questions in which every image supplies a necessary contribution.
blocks.zh:
组成证据(CE)使得答案取决于每个选定的目标的证据.
它通过支持的关系将检索到的事实连接起来,以构建一个联合问题,涉及多个图像中的多个实体,或者从多个图像中每个图像中的某个实体.
事实必须共同决定一个答案,同时删除任何指定捐款,使其无法确定。
因此,亚美尼亚共和国确定哪些证据是相关的,中央教育部具体规定了这些捐款如何确定答案。
这也支持多图像问题,每个图像都提供必要的贡献.

blocks.en:
The two operations recur as text and image searches reveal further targets or evidence, linking visual target resolution to subsequent search and the final answer.
A teacher solves the resulting tasks using only their images and questions.
We retain only trajectories whose final answers are judged correct against the reference answers for supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

两次行动随着文字和图像搜索的重复,揭示了更多的目标或证据,将视觉目标分辨率与随后的搜索和最终答案联系起来.
老师只用他们的图像和问题来解决由此产生的任务.
我们只保留根据监督微调(SFT)的参考答案判断最终答案正确的轨迹。

blocks.en: We make three contributions: • We frame task synthesis around making visually grounded search necessary for the answer. This perspective unifies identity leakage and unused entity evidence as breaks in the dependency from images, through targets and their evidence, to answers. • We introduce RACE, which constructs this dependency through Referential Abstraction and Compositional Evidence: the former ties target resolution to images, while the latter makes every selected target’s evidence necessary for joint questions within or across images. • We show that SFT on only 12K synthesized trajectories raises Qwen3.5-27B’s average accuracy from 53.5 to 56.0 across ten benchmarks (Table 1 ) and increases visual-tool use beyond the first round on all four primary benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 我们作出三项贡献: 我们把任务综合起来, 使视网膜搜索成为必要的答案。 这一视角将身份泄露和未使用的实体证据统一起来,作为从图像到目标及其证据对答案的依赖的突破。 我们引入了RACE,它通过参考抽象和构成证据构建了这种依赖性:前者将目标分辨率与图像联系起来,后者则使每个选定的目标的证据成为图像内部或图像之间的联合问题所必需的。 我们显示,只有12K的SFT合成轨迹将Quen3.5-27B的平均精度从53.5升至56.0,跨越10个基准(表1),并在所有四个主要基准的第一轮之后增加视觉工具的使用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Deep Search Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运深度搜索代理商

blocks.en:
Multimodal search agents learn to use image and text tools through supervised training or reinforcement learning (RL) ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Narayan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
OpenSearch-VL develops fine-grained visual tools ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , Vision-DeepResearch supports multi-turn, multi-entity, and multi-scale retrieval ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and HyperEyes optimizes parallel grounding and search ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
Other methods address visual evidence reuse ( Du et al., 2026 ) , context compression by rendering historical text observations as images ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , reasoning over retrieved images ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , and adaptive task generation ( Huang et al., 2026a ) .
DeepVoyager-VL combines intermediate visual dependencies with selective acquisition of visual evidence for long-horizon search ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
RACE focuses on how task structure determines the reasoning taught by successful trajectories.
It couples visual target discrimination with joint evidence use when constructing tasks for teacher supervision.
blocks.zh:
多式联运搜索人员通过监督培训或强化学习(RL)学习使用图像和文本工具(Geng等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年;Narayan等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年c).
OpenSearch-VL开发精致的视觉工具(Chen等人,2026年),Vision-DeepResearch支持多转弯,多实体,多尺度检索(Huang等人,2026b),HyperEyes优化了平行的地基定位和搜索(Li等人,2026年).
其他方法涉及视觉证据再利用(Du等人,2026年),通过将历史文字观测作为图像进行上下文压缩(Liu等人,2026年),对回收图像进行推理(Zhang等人,2026d),以及适应性任务生成(Huang等人,2026a).
DeepVoyager-VL结合中间视觉依赖性和选择性获取视觉证据进行长视距搜索(张等,2026b ).
RACE专注于任务结构如何决定成功轨迹所传授的推理.
它将视觉歧视与共同证据相结合,为教师建造监督任务。

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集和基准

blocks.en:
Knowledge-based VQA evaluates knowledge beyond image content ( Marino et al., 2019 ; Schwenk et al., 2022 ) and fine-grained entity information ( Chen et al., 2023 ) .
MMSearch and Vision-DeepResearch Benchmark evaluate multimodal retrieval and grounding ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
We evaluate on MMSearch-Plus, MM-BrowseComp, BrowseComp-V 3 , and VisBrowse-Bench, which emphasize provenance, multimodal browsing, and visual evidence verification ( Tao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) .
To generate training data for these agents, existing synthesis pipelines introduce images into textual tasks or knowledge paths ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , construct questions from complex images ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and incorporate visual-detail steps or webpage images ( Zhang et al., 2026d ; Du et al., 2026 ) .
Structured approaches use scene graphs ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) and image-rooted evidence hypergraphs ( Yao et al., 2026 ) .
DeepVoyager-VL composes event-graph programs with necessary intermediate visual evidence and minimal constraint sets for answer determination ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while HyperEyes constructs mosaic questions that require information from every selected entity ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
RACE formulates synthesis over visually grounded targets, with separate conditions for unique reference resolution and each target’s necessary contribution to a joint answer.
Coupling these conditions makes the reasoning requirements explicit at the target level, within scenes, across images, and throughout search.
blocks.zh:
基于知识的VQA评价超越图像内容的知识(Mino等人,2019年;Schwenk等人,2022年)和细纹实体信息(Chen等人,2023年).
MMSearch和远景-深入研究 基准评价多模式检索和定位(Jiang等人,2024年;Zeng等人,2026年)。
我们评价MMSearch-Plus,MM-BrowseComp,浏览器Comp-V 3,和VisBrowse-Bench,它们强调出处、多模式浏览和视觉证据核实(Tao等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;张等人,2026年a;张等人,2026年e).
为了为这些剂生成培训数据,现有的合成管道将图像引入文字任务或知识路径(Geng等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年),从复杂图像中构建问题(Huang等人,2026年b),并纳入视觉-细节步骤或网页图像(Zhang等人,2026年d;Du等人,2026年).
结构化方法采用场景图(Hudson and Manning, 2019;Yang等人, 2026)和图像固态证据超音速图(姚等人, 2026).
DeepVoyager-VL 编译事件图程序,包含必要的中间视觉证据和最小的求解约束集(Zhang等人,2026b),而HyperEyes则构建了需要来自每个选定实体的信息的镶嵌问题(Li等人,2026).
RACE对视网膜目标进行综合,对独特的参考分辨率和每个目标对共同答案的必要贡献有不同的条件。
将这些条件结合起来,使得推理要求在目标层面,场景内,图像之间,以及整个搜索过程中都明确.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
RACE synthesizes tasks around required dependencies from images to targets and from target-specific evidence to answers (Figure 2 ).
Referential Abstraction ties target resolution to image-grounded references. Compositional Evidence makes each selected target’s evidence necessary for the joint answer.
Ambiguous references are resolved through evidence retrieved for the depicted candidates.
Grounding and dependency feedback guide revisions within these operations, including when search introduces new images.
Teacher trajectories with correct final answers provide supervision for SFT.

引文将目标分辨率链接到基于图像的引用中。 组成证据使每个选定的目标的证据成为共同答复所必需的。
含糊不清的参考资料通过为被描绘的候选人收集的证据来解决。
在这些业务中,包括在搜索引入新图像时,定位和依赖性反馈指导修订。
有正确最终答案的教师轨迹为SFT提供监督.

blocks.zh: 3.1 图像化任务综合

blocks.en:
We start from real images to link target identification in natural scenes to verifiable external evidence.
Sources include social-media photographs, Bilibili video frames, and MovieNet film imagery ( Huang et al., 2020 ) .
Questions and reference answers are generated from grounded targets and retrieved evidence.
For unannotated images, lightweight filtering, visual analysis, and retrieval establish target identities.
MovieNet annotations provide identity-to-image correspondences.
Both routes supply grounded candidates and identity provenance to the generator.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate RACE under a shared student model and interaction environment.
We first compare answer accuracy before and after SFT, then analyze how training changes tool use and visual revisiting.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We train Qwen3.5-27B in one SFT stage using only 12K trajectories generated by Qwen3.7-Plus from our synthesized tasks.
Assistant tool calls and responses are supervised, while tool observations provide context.
The primary evaluation covers MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2025 ) , MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) , BrowseComp-V 3 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) .
These benchmarks assess fine-grained visual-cue use, multimodal retrieval and reasoning, and evidence acquisition and verification during browsing.
We report final-answer accuracy under each benchmark’s scoring protocol, separately from behavioral measures.
Evaluation sets are specified in Appendix A .
Supplementary comparisons cover BrowseComp-VL, VDR, MMSearch, SimpleVQA ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , LiveVQA ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , and FVQA ( Wang et al., 2016 ) (Table 1 ).
Avg. weights all ten benchmarks equally and is reported only for rows with complete aggregate scores.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results

blocks.en:
SFT improves Qwen3.5-27B on all four primary benchmarks by 2.2-5.0 percentage points, averaging 3.2 points under matched evaluation settings (Table 1 ).
Accuracy improves on nine of the ten evaluated benchmarks.

SFT改进了Quen3.5-27B 在所有四项主要基准中,以2.2-5.0个百分点计算,在相应的评价环境中平均为3.2个百分点(表1)。
在十项评估基准中,有九项的准确性有所提高。

blocks.en:
The largest improvements occur on BrowseComp-VL and BrowseComp-V 3 , at 6.3 and 5.0 points, respectively, compared with 0.5-1.1 points on SimpleVQA, LiveVQA, and FVQA (Table 1 ).

blocks.en:
5 Conclusion We introduced RACE, an image-conditioned task synthesis framework that constructs dependencies from images to targets and from their evidence to answers.
Referential Abstraction ties target resolution to image-grounded references, and Compositional Evidence connects the resolved targets’ evidence to a joint answer that requires every designated contribution.
Both operations apply to initial and retrieved images, so new observations can establish further targets or contribute answer evidence.
Grounding and dependency feedback refine the two operations during synthesis, with question-only probes identifying additional shortcuts.
Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B on only 12K teacher-generated trajectories raises average accuracy across ten multimodal benchmarks from 53.5 to 56.0, a gain of 2.5 points over the matched base agent.
blocks.zh:
5 结论 我们引入了基于图像的任务综合框架RACE, 构建从图像到目标以及从证据到答案的依赖性。
参考摘要将目标解析与基于图像的解析联系起来,组成证据将已解析目标的证据与需要每一项指定贡献的联合答案联系起来。
这两种操作都适用于初始和检索的图像,因此新的观测可以建立更多的目标或提供答案证据.
定位和依赖反馈在合成过程中完善了两种操作,只有问题探测器发现了额外的快捷方式.
微调 Quen3.5-27 B在只有12K师资生成的轨迹上,将10个多式联运基准的平均准确度从53.5提高到56.0,比对应的基剂增加2.5分。

blocks.en:
Source images include Weibo and X/Twitter photographs, Bilibili video frames, and MovieNet film imagery.

Candidate coverage for ambiguous relational references includes every entity matching the coarse visual description.
MovieNet identity annotations can pair frames containing the same person.
Cross-image target selection follows Equation 3 .

blocks.en:
Specific visual references use appearance, occlusion cues, or positional phrases computed from normalized bounding boxes: a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid, left-to-right order within a row, or row membership.

When enabled, the within-image multi-anchor constructor selects two grounded targets.

The two identities seed separate opening searches. The generator receives both images and the combined evidence, then constructs a relation supported by both targets’ facts.
Both images remain attached to the final question, with one image placeholder next to each corresponding reference.
A same-entity route also pairs two views for reference resolution.
Scene records store the selected targets, image associations, spatial cues, and routing decisions.
